page_title: ALA 1-0 ALM | Alaves v Almeria 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+8' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Almeria have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+6' The foul by Rafa Marin (Alaves) was seen by Juan Pulido who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+5' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' Aleksandar Sedlar is being substituted because of an injury. Luis Garcia Plaza sends Rafa Marin (Alaves) on the pitch.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Largie Ramazani trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marciano Sanca (Almeria).
87' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
87' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.
85' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.
83' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Alex Sola (Alaves) replaces Luis Rioja.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel will be replaced by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves).
83' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

83' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Corner kick. Almeria will have an opportunity.
82' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) takes a short corner kick.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luis Rioja (Alaves) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
79' 1 - 0 Goal! Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:0.
78' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
78' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) will take the free kick.
77' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
76' The total number of attempts is 15:9.
74' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Alaves! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Juan Pulido and both teams have no complaints.
73' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Alaves! Let's see what he decides.
73' That looked a certain handball by Chumi (Almeria) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
71' Gaizka Garitano has decided to substitute Leo Baptistao and he is replaced by Marko Milovanovic (Almeria).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) for Lucas Robertone.
69' Good movement by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
68' It is time for a substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is on for Ianis Hagi.
68' Here is a change. Kike Garcia is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Samu Omorodion (Alaves).
68' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ianis Hagi (Alaves). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
67' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Alaves earn a corner.
66' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
65' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
63' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Jon Guridi (Alaves) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
60' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

60' What a wasted opportunity by Kike Garcia (Alaves)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Luis Maximiano makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
59' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
58' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post.
57' Luis Rioja (Alaves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Almeria have a free kick.
56' Almeria work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

56' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) commits a foul and Juan Pulido immediately signals a free kick.
55' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
54' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
52' The expression of the referee Juan Pulido is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Luis Maximiano (Almeria) is shown a yellow card.
52' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' An accurate cross picks out Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
51' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
50' The attendance is 18380.
49' A snap shot by Sergio Arribas (Almeria) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Antonio Sivera produces a good save to thwart him.
49' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
47' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Half-time substitution. Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) will not participate anymore and Sergio Arribas is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gaizka Garitano probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Gonzalo Melero (Almeria). He is replaced by Adrian Embarba.
46' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
45+1' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45+1' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' It’s a PENALTY to Alaves after the VAR review!
44' There's a break in play and referee Juan Pulido must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Alaves using VAR. This could be interesting!
44' Kike Garcia (Alaves) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
42' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes it short.

42' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Luis Maximiano sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Good work from Alaves as they win a corner.
41' That's unlucky! Luis Rioja (Alaves) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
40' A pass from Javi Lopez (Alaves) is intercepted by Luis Maximiano and the move breaks down.
40' Kike Garcia (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
36' Javi Lopez (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
33' A cross by Luis Rioja (Alaves) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
30' Luis Rioja (Alaves) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Luis Maximiano is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
30' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
28' Luis Rioja finds Kike Garcia (Alaves) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he spanks the shot well wide of the left post.
26' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Largie Ramazani (Almeria) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
25' Yellow card. Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
24' Dangerous play by Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves). Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
23' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Pulido saw the whole situation. Alaves are awarded a free kick.
21' Ander Guevara (Alaves) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
20' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
20' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes the corner with a short pass.
20' Luis Rioja (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
18' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and it's Javi Lopez (Alaves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) attempts to find one of his teammates with a free kick, but the defence is well positioned and clears the ball away from danger.
16' The referee blows his whistle as Leo Baptistao (Almeria) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
14' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
14' Ander Guevara (Alaves) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
13' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) and blew his whistle.
12' The ball is cleared after Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes the corner which is cleared.
11' Luis Rioja (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
11' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
8' Jon Guridi (Alaves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
7' Almeria are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
3' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Ianis Hagi just over the bar.
3' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
1' Dion Lopy (Almeria) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Juan Pulido got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
